title.ko: 1강. 조건: -(으)면 과 ㄹ 받침 규칙의 시작
title.en: Lesson 1. If & When: -(으)면 and the ㄹ Rule

blocks.md:
To say **“if”** or **“when”** a condition is met, attach **-(으)면** to the verb or adjective stem:
- Stem with batchim → **-으면** *(먹다 → 먹으면)*
- Stem without batchim → **-면** *(가다 → 가면)*

**The ㄹ Batchim Exception**:

Verbs ending in **ㄹ** behave as if they have **NO batchim**! They attach **-면** directly without 으:

- 살다 (to live) → **살면** *(NOT 살으면 ❌)*
- 만들다 (to make) → **만들면** *(NOT 만들으면 ❌)*
- 알다 (to know) → **알면** *(NOT 알으면 ❌)*

items.tip: If you have time, let’s eat together.
If you live in Korea, your Korean improves quickly.
If you do not know, please ask.

blocks.q: How do you conjugate 살다 (to live) with -(으)면 (if)?
blocks.why: Verbs ending in ㄹ take -면 directly without 으: 살- + -면 = 살면.

blocks.meaning: If you have time this weekend, let’s watch a movie together.

blocks.hint: ㄹ batchim verbs attach -면 directly: 살- + -면 = 살면
blocks.why: Never say 살으면! Verbs ending in ㄹ drop the 으 and become 살면.

blocks.q: If you have time tomorrow, let's meet.

title.en: Lesson 2. Doing Two Things at Once: -(으)면서

blocks.md:
When one person does **two actions at the same time**, link them with **-(으)면서** (*“while doing...”*):
- Stem without batchim / ending in ㄹ → **-면서** *(가면서, 만들면서)*
- Stem with batchim → **-으면서** *(먹으면서, 읽으면서)*

items.tip: I study while listening to music.
I watch TV while eating food.

blocks.q: How do you say "while listening" with 듣다 (ㄷ irregular)?
blocks.why: Remember from Stage 2: ㄷ irregular becomes ㄹ before a vowel! 듣다 → 들으면서.

blocks.meaning: I talked with my friend while drinking coffee.
blocks.why: 마시다 has no batchim, so it attaches -면서: 마시면서.

blocks.q: Put in order: "I clean my room while listening to music."
I listen to music while studying.

blocks.md:
To express an **“either / or”** choice between two **verbs or adjectives**, attach **-거나** directly to the stem.

- 주말에 영화를 **보거나** 운동해요. *(On weekends, I watch movies or exercise.)*

**Noun vs Verb “Or”**:
- Noun + **(이)나**: 커피**나** 차 *(Coffee or tea)*
- Verb + **-거나**: 마시**거나** 쉬어요 *(Drink or rest)*

blocks.q: Match nouns with (이)나 and verbs with -거나:

blocks.meaning: On weekends, I rest at home or read books.

blocks.hint: For verbs, use -거나, not -(이)나 (which is for nouns)!
blocks.why: Verbs take -거나 for choices: 보- + -거나 = 보거나.

blocks.q: On weekends, I rest at home or meet friends.
blocks.hint: 주말에, 집에서 쉬다 → 쉬거나, 친구를 만나요

title.ko: 4강. 세 연결 어미 종합: 조건·동시·선택 가려 쓰기
title.en: Lesson 4. Choosing the Right Connector: Condition, Simultaneity, or Choice

blocks.md:
Let's review when to use each of these three essential sentence linkers:

- **-(으)면 (If / When):** Sets up a **condition** or assumption. (시간이 있**으면** 만나요 / If you have time, let's meet).
- **-(으)면서 (While):** Describes **two actions done at the same time by the same person**. (음악을 들**으면서** 공부해요 / I study while listening to music).
- **-거나 (Or):** Chooses between **two alternative actions or states**. (영화를 보**거나** 책을 읽어요 / I watch a movie or read a book).
Special stem reminder: ㄹ stems do NOT take 으! **살다** → 살면 / 살면서. **만들다** → 만들면 / 만들면서. But ㄷ irregulars turn ㄷ into ㄹ before 으: **듣다** → 들으면 / 들으면서!

items.ch: 주말에 시간이 있으면 같이 밥 먹어요.
items.tip: If you have time this weekend, let’s eat together. (-(으)면 condition)
I watch TV while eating a meal. (-(으)면서 simultaneous actions)

items.ch: 주말에는 보통 집에서 쉬거나 영화를 봐요.
items.tip: On weekends I usually rest at home or watch a movie. (-거나 choice)

blocks.q: Which connector expresses doing two actions simultaneously (while): “I chat with my friend while drinking coffee”?
blocks.why: To describe two actions happening at the same time by the same person, use -(으)면서: 마시다 + -면서 → **마시면서**.

blocks.q: How do you correctly conjugate ‘만들다’ (to make, ㄹ stem) with ‘-(으)면서’ (while)?
blocks.why: Stems ending in ㄹ attach -면서 directly without 으: 만들 + 면서 → **만들면서**.

blocks.q: Match each verb and connector combination with its meaning.

blocks.meaning: If the weather is good, let's go for a walk to the Han River.
blocks.why: 좋다 + -(으)면 expresses the condition: “If it is good” → **좋으면**.

blocks.q: Combine 걷다 (to walk, ㄷ irregular) with -(으)면서: 「산책로를 ___ 음악을 들어요.」
blocks.why: 걷다 changes ㄷ to ㄹ before vowels: 걷다 + -으면서 → **걸으면서**.

blocks.say: 주말에는 보통 집에서 책을 읽거나 친구를 만나요.
blocks.rom: ju-mal-e-neun bo-tong jib-e-seo chaeg-eul ilg-geo-na chin-gu-reul man-na-yo
blocks.q: Read aloud naturally expressing alternate weekend plans.
